proves.claim: with inbox.batchedMarks off, or with ports lacking handOffDelivery, delivery records through ordered and writes the mark inline, and acted ids still go through ordered

activity.inbox.batched-delivery-off.why: Without this case a regression in batched inbox delivery would pass the gate unnoticed.

proves.claim: with inbox.batchedMarks on, a read with a fresh interrupt hands its delivery and mark off and opens no write board

activity.inbox.batched-delivery-on.why: Without this case a regression in batched inbox delivery would pass the gate unnoticed.

proves.claim: with inbox.batchedMarks on, delivery enqueues the inbox mark and writes none inline.

activity.inbox.batched-marks-on.why: Inline mark writes slowed every delivery.

proves.claim: with inbox.batchedMarks off, delivery writes the mark as on main, and the setting is described.

activity.inbox.batched-marks-off.why: The default path must stay unchanged and the setting must be documented.

proves.claim: a shout naming an open item in this seat's lane ends the wait.

activity.wait-shout.own-lane-ends.why: A seat in its lane must hear work meant for it.

proves.claim: a shout naming an open item in another lane is printed and the wait continues.

activity.wait-shout.other-lane-continues.why: A foreign-lane shout woke seats that could not act on it.

proves.claim: a shout naming an item another seat holds is printed and the wait continues.

activity.wait-shout.other-seat-item-cont.why: A shout about another seat's item woke every idle seat.

proves.claim: a shout naming an item this seat holds ends the wait.

activity.wait-shout.own-item-ends.why: The holder of an item must hear shouts about it.

proves.claim: a burst of file changes runs one refresh, not one per file.

activity.wait.coalesced-refresh.why: One refresh per file made a waiting seat do needless work.

proves.claim: a file waiter waiting 5 s on an unchanged board file uses under 0.5 s of process CPU.

activity.io-wait.idle-wait-no-spin.why: Waiting seats that busy-polled pushed the machine to load 45.

proves.claim: a write to the watched board file during the wait wakes it within 1 s.

activity.io-wait.wakes-on-write.why: A sleeping waiter must still hear a board write at once.

proves.claim: closing a waiter cancels its pending pass.

activity.wait.close-cancels-pass.why: A pass left pending after close kept a dead waiter alive.

proves.claim: a costly wake spaces the next pass by a capped multiple of its cost, and a quiet change is not delayed.

activity.wait.costly-wake-spacing.why: Costly wakes stacked passes and starved the machine.

proves.claim: each claimed seat's worktree is read from Git against its claim base, and a seat with no checkout reads unknown.

activity.worktrees.claim-base-read.why: A missing checkout must not read as no edits.

proves.claim: overlap lines name a shared edit and an out-of-scope edit to the holder only, and an unobserved claim is named unknown.

activity.worktrees.overlap-lines.why: Overlap lines reached the wrong seat or hid unobserved claims.

proves.claim: background maintenance records each claim's files, and a later read answers from the record with no Git.

activity.worktrees.maintenance-record.why: Reading claim files from Git on every call was slow.

proves.claim: a landed commit names the files it changed against its base, and an unreadable pair is unknown.

activity.worktrees.landed-commit-files.why: An unreadable commit pair must not read as no change.

proves.claim: the file waiter wakes on a change made before it sleeps, honours a past deadline, and settles on close.

activity.worktrees.file-waiter.why: A change made just before sleeping was missed.

proves.claim: delivery interrupts for what happened to this seat's own work and counts the rest.

activity.delivery.interrupt-own-work.why: Seats were interrupted by events about other seats' work.

proves.claim: an answer to this seat's decision interrupts, and shouts and typed requests stay direct.

activity.delivery.decision-answer-interr.why: A decision answer sat unread while the seat worked.

proves.claim: a claim whose lease ends within five minutes interrupts, and a distant, foreign or unclaimed one does not.

activity.delivery.lease-ending-interrupt.why: A lease lapsed with no warning to its holder.

proves.claim: a budget big enough keeps everything, and one too small keeps nothing and names what it withheld.

activity.delivery.budget-big-keeps-all.why: A silent drop hid withheld activity.

proves.claim: a middling budget keeps whole groups within its byte limit and never splits a shout's text.

activity.delivery.budget-middling-whole-.why: A cut shout lost half its meaning.

proves.claim: only the coordinator actions count as call-outs, and the subject of one is the first item it names.

activity.callouts.coordinator-actions-on.why: Non-actionable shouts inflated the call-out count.

proves.claim: a call-out stays open until it is answered, its item changed or its item moved on.

activity.callouts.open-until-answered.why: Answered call-outs stayed on the board.

proves.claim: the call-out line speaks only once the oldest is past fifteen minutes, in the singular or plural, naming who to tell.

activity.callouts.line-after-fifteen-min.why: Fresh call-outs nagged before anyone could answer.

proves.claim: the board's call-out line counts the unanswered actionable shouts to the coordinator about items still open.

activity.callouts.board-line-count.why: The count included closed items and answered shouts.

proves.claim: every statement coordinatorCalloutLine prepares has an indexed query plan and no statement reads answered shout history.

activity.io-callouts.reads-open-callouts.why: A full shout-history read on every next made the coordinator call-out line grow with board history.

proves.claim: with 4,342 answered and unrelated coordinator shouts the median of 20 reads is under 200 ms and at most 2x the median with 10 shouts.

activity.io-callouts.cost-flat-with-shou.why: A call-out read that gets slower as answered shout history grows slows every next command.

proves.claim: a seat idling in next --wait hears each unread shout once and is told the open item it is asked to act on.

activity.delivery.next-wait-hears-shouts.why: Repeated shouts woke idle seats again and again.

proves.claim: the activity cursor replays from the start until saved, and a cursor saved for another agent or board is not trusted.

activity.delivery.cursor-replay.why: A foreign cursor skipped real activity.

proves.claim: every activity-cell test has a stable ID and one complete record.

activity.registry.complete.why: Unregistered tests left no stated claim to review.

proves.claim: every test file in packages/activity/tests that reads files carries an input header naming the cells it reads, and none names the whole tree.

activity.inputs.every-reader-declares-it.why: Without it this behaviour could regress with no test naming what it proved.
